newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 520 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 520 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 520 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.
The Bank allotted 506 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before May 7 and 14 million stg in repos to May 6 and 7.
It revised its forecast money market shortage to 1.55 billion stg and has now provided total liquidity of 1.567 billion stg on Monday.
